## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm check:docs` pass
- [ ] `docs/` and TSDoc describe any behavior change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry, and `package.json` has the new version if this PR is a release
- [ ] No certificates, personal data or real taxpayer data (see AGENTS.md)
